title: funny, but they worked
text: funny, but they worked. I bought these more of a joke for one of our crab boils... but some actually used them!  They came folded in squares, set of 4.  They are super thin, but plastic... so it does sort of make a barrier of a sort.  The ties are pretty week, so don't tie too vigourously!

description: Listen up, lobster lovers! Use this set of two Lobster Bibs from Nantucket Seafood to protect your clothes from butter and juice at your next seafood feast. Made of cotton featuring an embroidered festive red lobster to fit the occasion, you can simply throw them in the washing machine after use to clean. Great for lobster or crawfish fests, parties, or family meals at home. Focus on enjoying the delicious food in front of you, without worrying about drips and stains during your next shellfish meal!
